name: Asset Import & Setup
description: Scans a folder for assets, detects types, applies matching presets, and generates a change summary.
toolGroupNotes: Every tool in this workflow (manage_asset, batch_execute, read_console) is in the bridge's default-on `core` group, so no manage_tools activation step is needed. On Unity 6.4, note that a dependent asset reimports only when its dependency's import result changes -- a project with custom ScriptedImporter/AssetPostprocessor code may need explicit DependsOnSourceAsset/DependsOnArtifact declarations for a batch apply to propagate (source: https://docs.unity.com/en-us/engine/6000.6/manual/upgrade-guides/upgrade-guide-unity64, retrieved 2026-10-21). See steering/asset-automation.md.

steps.name: Detect asset types by naming patterns (per matched asset)
Apply matching presets via batch execute (fail_fast must be false so one bad asset does not abandon the rest)
